description_en: Queries the execution status of backup tasks for a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的备份任务执行情况
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-backup-tasks --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --backup-job-id 11620000 --job-mode Manual --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup task.

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473819.html operation to perform a manual backup task, you can set this parameter to the returned backup ID to query the backup progress of the task
parameters.help_zh:
备份任务ID。
如果您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473819.html执行了手动备份，您可以将返回的备份ID传入，用以查询备份的进度
parameters.name: backup_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473822.html operation to query the automatic backup policy.
Manual: manual backup.

By default, the information about backup tasks in both modes is returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值：
Automated：系统自动备份，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473822.html查询自动备份策略。
Manual：手动备份

默认返回所有备份模式的任务信息
parameters.name: job_mode

BackupJobs.description_en: The details of the backup tasks

BackupJobID.description_en: The ID of the backup task

BackupProgressStatus.description_en:
The state of the backup task. Valid values:

NoStart: The backup task is not started.
Preparing: The backup task is being prepared.
Waiting: The backup task is pending.
Uploading: The system is uploading the backup file.
Checking: The system is checking the uploaded backup file.
Finished: The backup task is completed
BackupProgressStatus.description_zh:
备份任务状态，返回值：
NoStart：未开始。
Preparing：准备中。
Waiting：等待中。
Uploading：上传中
Checking：检查中。
Finished：已完成

JobMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: automatic backup
Manual: manual backup
JobMode.description_zh:
备份模式，返回值：
Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the data node

Process.description_en: The progress of the backup task in percentage
Process.description_zh: 备份任务进度百分比（不推荐，请查看Progress参数）

Progress.description_zh: 备份的进度百分比，取值为0-100

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup task. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

TaskAction.description_en:
The type of the backup task. Valid values:

TempBackupTask: The backup task was manually performed.
NormalBackupTask: The backup task was automatically performed
TaskAction.description_zh:
备份任务类型，返回值：
TempBackupTask：临时备份任务，即手动备份。
NormalBackupTask：普通备份任务，即自动备份
